#include <iostream>
#include <memory>

class NumberBox {
private:
    int number;

public:
    NumberBox(int n) : number(n) {
    }

    int getNumber() const {
        return number;
    }

    void setNumber(int n) {
        number = n;
    }
};

int main() {
    auto ptr1 = std::make_unique<NumberBox>(10);
    auto ptr2 = std::move(ptr1);

    if (ptr1) {
        std::cout << "ptr1 has value: " << ptr1->getNumber() << "\n";
    }

    if (ptr2) {
        std::cout << "The value in *ptr2 is: " << ptr2->getNumber() << "\n";

        ptr2->setNumber(99);
        std::cout << "The value after setNumber(99) is: " << ptr2->getNumber() << "\n";

        ptr2.reset();
        
        if (ptr2) {
            std::cout << "ptr2 still has data.\n";
        } else {
            std::cout << "ptr2 is empty after reset.\n";
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
b: The value in *ptr2 is: 10 The value after setNumber(99) is: 99 ptr2 is empty after reset.
